consumers.meaning: Green run peak provider validates preceding stored tag and selected start, extends contiguous run backward then delegates inclusive maximum; no tag recomputation.

Breakout first strict lower high crossing; minimum through crossing inclusive. Maps minimum timestamp to selected main row; absent crossing or owner returns None. Native time window starts from truthy intrabar_start or derived index; not a new event chosen by main-source mapping.

Confirmed box opposite edge uses inclusive extrema; if owning source index equals Break, conditionally replace with exact intrabar analysis. Candidate mutated before shallow dataclass replace appended to direction ledger; no blanket rollback. Complete append semantics remain for later local pass.

Remainder admission requires matching tag and nonnull analysis. Reject strict opposite crossing after event+1 microsecond. Then consume full candle lower window, choose extrema with timestamp tie keys; no rows returns None. Candidate provenance on main candle. Full caller ownership review pending.

Gate confirmation helper uses earlier/equal Break indexes when earlier or no exact gate; same-index case scans generator half-open and returns first strict hit <= gate, fallback main open <= gate. This is separate from MarketChronology confirmation cache.
